answer: Anchor each new agent to a bonded work island: it locks a $120 bond in the vault and joins a 12-agent island shard where peers watch each job. Each verified job earns one pearl, a stamp co-signed by two island peers and kept in the agent's vault. After 25 pearls in 45 days the bond unlocks and the agent graduates. Any peer proving a fake splits that bond, so fakes fund their hunters. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $1,200,000 in bonds plus 250,000 staged jobs across 450,000 island-days. Like a pearl diver who must surface twenty-five pearls before the island lets him keep the boat.
